title: 18 Brush customization and the pop-up palette

bites.title: Make it yours
bites.body: Every preset is a starting point. Change it, save it under your own name, and keep your favorites one right-click away.

bites.title: Tweak and save
bites.body: In the editor, change something you can feel: the Size curve under pressure, or the tip's spacing. Then click Save New Brush Preset and give it your name.
bites.hint: Overwrite Brush saves over the original. Save New keeps the original safe.

bites.title: The pop-up palette
bites.body: Right-click on the canvas (or your pen's barrel button). The pop-up palette: a ring of favorite brushes, a color wheel, and recent colors. Click anywhere to close it.
bites.hint: Pen button does nothing? Map it to right-click in your tablet driver.

bites.title: Favorites
bites.body: The ring shows the brushes in your favorite tag. In Brush Presets, right-click a preset and assign it to a tag, then choose which tag the pop-up shows in Settings > Configure Krita > General > Miscellaneous (pop-up palette).

bites.title: Your pen buttons
bites.body: Two barrel buttons are prime real estate. Common choices: right-click (pop-up palette) and middle-click (pan). Set them in your tablet driver. Krita's own mapping lives in Settings > Configure Krita > Canvas Input Settings.

bites.title: 18 cleared
bites.body: Your brushes, your ring, your buttons. The tools fit your hand now.
